says: In next/, the C5 law's title says the rejection is kept 'as its cause or in the one RpcCallError a Connection call wraps it in', but since T502 S2 every ProcessClient call wraps it in an RpcCallError too, and the comment at :89 still says every client call goes through `catch: unreachable`.
proof: error-cause.test.ts:96 names only a Connection call, while error-cause.test.ts:75-76 is `const throughStub = (client, method) => client === "process" || (client === "gateway" && method !== "fetch")`, and platform.ts builds every ProcessClient method as `reach(process.x(...), lost)`, not with `unreachable`.
cost: A reader of a red C5 run is told the wrong set of clients go through Alchemy's typed stub, and S3 will widen the gap again.
